This isn't exactly a date, but I did briefly try to use okcupid to find friends. It was the very first thing in my profile, and I always clarified with people that I had a boyfriend and was not looking for anything sexual or romantic at all- I was just trying to meet people in a new town. One time I messaged someone who I saw taught in my area. Since I was training to be a teacher, I thought that this would be a good way to meet someone who already knew a bit more than me, and we would have something to talk about.

We met at a restaurant and ate ice cream, talked about some teachery stuff, no problems. We weren't really making a connection as much as I had hoped, but it was fine. He asked if I wanted to hang out at his apartment, and I said yes, first mistake. When we got there, we watched a movie. I sat down on the opposite end of the couch. He said something like "Come closer, I won't bite." Red flag #1. I clarified that I had a boyfriend and wasn't looking for romance, and he said he knew that.

We were watching the movie and chatting a little about how silly okcupid can be, and we got on the subject of people who give really bad answers to questions on their profile. He started bringing up how I'm bisexual and asking what kinds of girls I was into / talking what he liked in a girl / asking about sexual experiences. I was getting a little uncomfortable, but tried to act normal and keep up the conversation, because I didn't want to lose a professional contact. And also, he said that he was looking for a serious relationship (which I couldn't offer because I was obviously in a relationship) and that he liked thin girls (and I was pretty chunky).

Then I said "oh, hold on, my boyfriend's mad because I didn't update him on where I am- I just need to let him know I went to your house." and he FLIPPED OUT. He got mad that I had told my boyfriend who he was and where his house was in case I got murdered, and then yelled at me a lot for assuming that he wanted sex when obviously he didn't and then kicked me out and then took it back and then kicked me out again and then insisted on giving me a hug.

I felt really bad, because he had seemed really offended, so I apologized via text and said that I knew how much teachers have to worry about their reputations and that I certainly wouldn't tell anyone anything malicious about him. I also said I understood if he didn't want to hang out. He kept alternately saying he wanted to hang out and sending me really angry texts, which freaked me out. I stopped responding with more than one word after a while. His last text to me was just a winky face, sent with no context at 11:30 pm. He scared the shit out of me. I still get nervous every time I go near his neighborhood.

MORAL OF THE STORY: If someone at any point seems like a bit of a crazy person, MAKE AN EXCUSE AND LEAVE. Also, don't go to people's houses on the first hangout.

I use a eh pro kayfun lite V2. Right now they are around $25. Super reliable tank setup. I fill mine up at night, and I chain vape it the next day and I am able to get a full 24 hours out of it. Rebuilding coils and wicking is a breeze, along with assembly and disassembly. Its so simple to do that I actually rewick everyday. When the tank is empty, I disassemble and rinse under hot water briefly. I wick new cotton it, prime the cotton with a few drops of liquid and reassemble the tank. Fill it up and you are good to go. The whole process takes me about 5 minutes.

Very minimal leaking, easy to clean, and cheap to purchase. Also, its consistent as hell. I don't ever get dry hits or gurgling. The only time it leaks is when it sits in my car in 100+ degree weather. Even then it will only leak a drop or two. Every hit is consistent flavor and vapor production. I won't be switching tanks for a long time.
